g.text: H-NOTES-CORPUS: speaker-note detection on real TeX output, pre-registered (scientific/13)
the corpus
: 19 Beamer sources (a-p, stale-v1, stale-v2),
every note command carrying a marker of its own (NOTEMARK1X, …),
the templated sources taking their note template from the
command line (default, compressed, plain, lined)
derive-expectations.cjs
: ADR-0048 §2 by brute force (every
slide/note assignment checked against rules 1-3), the plan and
settle table, and SIG and ROTATED-DATE predicted by the content
model M1-M4, giving expectations.json for 94 artifacts
the registration
: the sha256 of expectations.json is written
into PREREGISTRATION.md. Neither file changes after this point
the pre-look
(--no-detector): compile the corpus and read
the oracle, then stop. The bundle is neither loaded nor run
the run
, into a fresh directory (a non-empty one is refused):
each artifact compiled in a directory of its own under taskset -c 16-23,
pdflatex ×1 · lualatex ×1 · xelatex ×1 · xelatex ×2, and the stale case,
v1 ×2 then v2 ×1 over v1's .aux (xelatex, and lualatex as the control)
the comparison
, artifact by artifact. H1: the five fields against
expectations.json. H2: S1
and S2
Beside them P-labels, P-hidden, P-instrument and P-twin
UNSAFE
, reported first: the artifact, its labels,
the pages and the rule that fired
a deviation
, analysed without changing any code and
attributed to the detector, the expectation (M1-M3 or the
derivation) or the oracle. expectations.json is never edited
S1 fails: a slide is hidden?
yes
a field differs from its expectation,
or S2 fails?
yes
as registered
: the decision, and the safety class
(exact, no notes, or shown as it is)
the record
: the table and the summary on the console (tee'd),
and the results JSON, every path relative to the output directory,
copied to docs/scientific/data/13/
, the note pages: the pages whose text holds a marker.
A lined artifact takes its default twin's
(M4, checked on
the templates that draw the note text). A two-screen deck has
(every page doubles the paper, checked)
vv --cli --deck-info
, one line per PDF: notes · notePages ·
notesProof · notesReason · frames
, the hidden set: the same bundle loaded without its main,
evidence/detect called as cli.core/deck-info calls it, and its
note pages read. Their count, style, proof and reason are checked
against the CLI's line (P-instrument)
no
corpus and registration (scripts/notes-corpus/)
the experiment (scripts/exp-notes-corpus.cjs)
oracle (pdf.js legacy build: page text)
detector under test (dist/cli/vv-cli.js: vinary.slides.*)
Colour
Swimlane / concept
the corpus and the registration, fixed before the detector first runs
the experiment script: compiling (pinned), collecting, comparing
the oracle: pdf.js page text and the markers, independent of the detector
the detector under test: the vinary.slides.* models as vv runs them
a refutation: a hidden slide, or a decision other than the registered one
as registered
The run of 2026-10-18: 94 of 94 decisions as registered, S1 held in 94 of 94, S2 in 54 of 54.
